prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System = Regional Flow Platform (Cedarbell). Airports Meridian International, Harbor East, North Valley, Lakeside Regional, Southport keep safety authority. TOBT=Target Off Block Time: issued only if capacity/ground path allow; frozen at horizon unless exception recorded; revised only on turnaround-actor confirmation. Modes: Normal Operations; Adverse Weather Mode (Duty Manager may reduce remote stand use); Recovery Phase (remote stands absorb late arrivals, contact gates kept for tight turnarounds); Capacity Reduction State (Registry may tighten escalation, suppress low-impact issues); Contingency Fallback State (Contingency Operations Console). Elements: Demand Prediction Service (Marlinstone; Flight Intent Message vs Airport Capacity Plan; AAR=Airport Acceptance Rate; unknown border status makes turnaround milestone uncertain); Capacity Assessment Module (CAM; remote stand limits, persistent apron congestion reduce throughput); Slot Allocation Engine (Blueharbor; CTT=Calculated Takeoff Time; Ground Delay Program; Pushback Window Token; no aggressive sequence slot under unresolved customs hold); Departure Metering Service (Emberline; TOBT protects CTT; CTT to TSM); North/South Runway Meters; Surface Surveillance Adapter (normalizes apron data into movement/occupancy/blockage events); East Apron Sensor (occupancy transitions, pushback lane blockage, confidence, synced time); West Apron Sensor (verifies remote stands/service roads); Airport CDM Portal (Foxglove; Common Situation Display; Collaborative Decision Log; controlled-access customs view); Tower Sequence Manager (TSM, Ironleaf; SHALL NOT advance aircraft unless remote stand release supports taxi plan; considers apron blockage); Gate Conflict Detector (Gate Reopening Memo; uses border/apron evidence); Airline Interface Adapter (Late Baggage Tag List to Ground Handling Dispatcher); Handling Resource Planner (Remote Stand Shuttle Count); Alert Distribution Hub (Lantern; MUST meet advisory latency); Ramp Movement Board (Skylark; Fuel Truck Hold Advice; MUST refresh apron layer within 5 s); Audit Event Ledger (MUST record adjustments, actors, overrides, exceptions; Identity Access Service); Business Rules Registry (border states: blocking/human-confirm/informational); Sector Load Monitor (Departure Fix Load Sheet); Performance Analytics Warehouse; Time Synchronization Service (aligns customs/apron events with CTT/TOBT); Arrival Regulation Console (Nightjar; uses Medical Diversion Notice); Integrated Tactical Management Position; Weather Ingest Gateway (Orchard); Digital

New part:
S587: The Data Governance Steward maintains the access rules and retention rules for border and customs data because the data can affect both operational outcomes and passenger privacy obligations.
S588: The Alert Distribution Hub issues targeted alerts when a customs hold conflicts with an assigned stand plan or when apron sensing contradicts a declared off-block milestone.
S589: The Collaborative Decision Log records the operational reason when border release status, customs hold status, or apron sensing data changes a sequencing or stand allocation decision.
S590: The Performance Analytics Warehouse compares planned clearance assumptions with actual border release timing and apron availability to improve future demand prediction and resource planning.
S591: The airport-level constraint process starts by translating en-route demand indicators into rates, time windows, and advisories that can be understood by local operations teams.
S592: Each Sector Load Monitor supplies time-bucketed counts, predicted occupancy, and overload flags for the sectors that feed or constrain Meridian arrivals and departures.
S593: The Regional Flow Platform aligns these sector values with scheduled movements from Flight Data Exchange and predicted readiness from Demand Prediction Service.
S594: When a sector is predicted to exceed its planning threshold, Capacity Assessment Module evaluates whether the affected traffic is dominated by departures, arrivals, or mixed flows.
S595: For departure-dominated overload, the conversion result is normally an airport departure rate, a constrained departure fix allocation, or a proposed spacing value at the runway release point.
S596: For arrival-dominated overload, the result is expressed as an adjusted Airport Acceptance Rate or a metered arrival stream for Arrival Regulation Console.
S597: Mixed-flow constraints are converted into paired measures so that departure metering does not protect one sector by creating an unmanaged arrival queue.
S598: The Regional Flow Manager uses the load sheet to confirm whether a departure fix constraint should be represented as an airport departure measure.
S599: Departure fix saturation is calculated by comparing planned departures by fix against the usable fix capacity declared in Airport Capacity Plan.
S600: Capacity Assessment Module applies Business Rules Registry thresholds to distinguish a short tactical peak from sustained saturation requiring a Tactical Regulation Proposal.
S601: A short peak normally becomes a sequence advisory in Tower Sequence Manager or a limited departure metering adjustment in Departure Metering Service.
S602: Sustained saturation is converted into revised Calculated Takeoff Time targets and, when necessary, adjusted Target Off Block Time values published through Airport CDM Portal.
S603: The Slot Allocation Engine preserves equity by distributing delay across operators according to the active Ground Delay Program logic and local priority rules.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
